verses.text: This is the vision Obadiah saw. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard a message from the LORD. A messenger was sent to the nations to say, "Get up! Let us go to war against Edom!"
"Edom, I will make you small among the nations. Everyone will look down on you.
Your proud heart has fooled you. You live in the safety of the rocky cliffs, and you make your home high in the mountains. You say to yourself, 'Who can bring me down to the ground?'
Even if you fly as high as an eagle and build your nest among the stars, I will bring you down from there," says the LORD.

"If thieves came to you, if robbers came at night, what a disaster that would be! Wouldn't they steal only as much as they wanted? If people came to pick your grapes, wouldn't they leave a few grapes behind?
But Esau will be completely robbed! His hidden treasures will be searched out and taken!
All your allies will push you out to the border. Your friends will trick you and overpower you. Those who eat your bread will set a trap for you, and you will not even notice it."
"On that day," says the LORD, "I will destroy the wise people of Edom and the people with understanding in the mountains of Esau.
Your warriors, Teman, will be terrified, and everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.
Because of the violence you did to your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and destroyed forever.
On the day you stood off to the side, while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and threw dice for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.

You should not have looked down on your brother on the day of his trouble. You should not have celebrated over the people of Judah on the day of their destruction. You should not have bragged on the day of their distress.

You should not have marched through the gates of my people on the day of their disaster. You should not have looked down on their suffering on the day of their disaster. You should not have grabbed their wealth on the day of their disaster.
You should not have waited at the crossroads to cut down those who were escaping. You should not have handed over the survivors on the day of their distress.
"The day of the LORD is near for all nations. What you have done will be done to you. What you have done to others will come back on your own head.
Just as you drank on my holy mountain, so all the nations will keep on drinking. They will drink and drink until they disappear as if they had never existed.
But on Mount Zion there will be people who escape, and it will be holy. The family of Jacob will take back their own land.

The family of Jacob will be a fire, and the family of Joseph a flame. The family of Esau will be dry straw. They will set it on fire and burn it up. There will be no survivors from the family of Esau." The LORD has spoken.

People from the Negev in the south will take over the mountains of Esau. People from the western foothills will take over the land of the Philistines. They will take over the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will take over Gilead.
This army of captives from Israel who live among the Canaanites will take over the land as far as Zarephath. The captives from Jerusalem who live in Sepharad will take over the towns of the Negev.
Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
